issue: Drag-to-rotate does not work; panorama never rotates from mouse drag input.
actual: Dispatched real trusted mousedown→mousemove→mouseup gestures on the drag container (confirmed via captured event log, e.g. mousedown at 640,432 then mousemove to 941,433 then mouseup) in both horizontal (~300px) and vertical (~200-150px) directions, twice each. In every case the scene transform (rotateX/translateX) and all hotspot left/top positions remained completely unchanged (e.g. "scale(1) rotateX(0deg) translateX(0px)" before and after). Only the zoom +/- buttons visibly changed the scene (scale value), confirming the app is responsive but the drag-rotate gesture itself is non-functional, so users cannot rotate the panorama 360° or see hotspots wrap around via dragging as instructed by the on-screen hint "拖拽旋转 • 滚轮缩放 • 点击热点探索".
evidence: React props on the drag container include onMouseDown/onMouseMove/onMouseUp/onWheel handlers, so drag is intended to work, but state never updated despite real dispatched events with substantial deltas in both axes.

With sort set to "按年份" (list reordered to 昆曲, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂, 春节...), navigated into 昆曲 detail page and back (browser back). The homepage still showed sort combobox = "按年份" and the same reordered list, confirming sort selection persisted across detail-page navigation.

Each of the 8 heritage cards uses a distinct image (8 unique src URLs, no duplicates/generic placeholder reuse) and each img's alt attribute exactly matches its heritage item's Chinese name (e.g. alt="京剧" for the Peking Opera card, alt="苏绣" for Suzhou Embroidery), indicating images are individually assigned per item rather than a shared/mismatched default.
